newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-DENILSON FAVOURS REAL MADRID MOVE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DENILSON FAVOURS REAL MADRID MOVE.

text.p: Brazilian international striker Denilson of Sao Paulo was quoted on Saturday as saying he hopes to join Spanish champions Real Madrid if his present club will let him go.
The Spanish sports daily 'Marca' quoted Denilson as saying: "If it were up to me, I'd go to Real right now.
"But ... it depends on Sao Paulo, and now the club has said it's not prepared to negotiate with anybody," added the player, who has been widely linked with the Madrid side.
Denilson said he thought Sao Paulo wanted to keep him until next summer's World Cup, where a good performance could significantly increase his transfer value.
Press reports have suggested Real are ready to pay as much as three billion pesetas ($20.7 million) for Denilson.
Denilson, 19, shot to prominence with his fine play in Brazil's recent Copa America triumph.
